notes.title: Nitro Nation VR Pre-Alpha Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!👋

Finally, you can check out the pre-alpha demo through Steam Next Festival. It includes a short ~30 minute single-player campaign as well as a garage with some basic functionality (upgrades, mini games).

[previewyoutube=HBk6WZdk9KY;full][/previewyoutube]

Your feedback on the demo would mean a lot to us! How does the driving feel, what would you want to see added, your likes/dislikes about the mechanics, any technical issues you encountered, and more.

Please feel free to share your feedback through  Steam Discussions  and we’ll gladly respond!😊
